title: The Hobbit
author: J.R.R. Tolkien
description: A hobbit leaves his peaceful home and joins an adventure involving dwarves dragons and a dangerous journey.

title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
author: J.K. Rowling
description: A young boy discovers that he is a wizard and begins his education at a magical school where he encounters friendship mystery and danger.

title: Percy Jackson and the Lightning Thief
author: Rick Riordan
description: A teenager discovers that Greek mythology is real and embarks on a dangerous quest involving gods monsters and friendship.

title: The Hunger Games
author: Suzanne Collins
description: A young woman is forced to participate in a dangerous competition where participants fight for survival in a dystopian society.

title: Divergent
author: Veronica Roth
description: A young woman living in a divided society discovers that she does not fit into a single social group and becomes involved in a dangerous conflict.

title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
description: A young woman navigates love family expectations social class and relationships in nineteenth century England.

title: Jane Eyre
author: Charlotte Bronte
description: An independent young woman faces hardship and discovers love while working as a governess in England.

title: The Fault in Our Stars
author: John Green
description: Two teenagers meet and develop a meaningful relationship while dealing with difficult circumstances.

title: The Maze Runner
author: James Dashner
description: A teenage boy wakes up in a mysterious enclosed community with no memory and must work with others to escape.

title: The Chronicles of Narnia
author: C.S. Lewis
description: Children enter a magical world where they encounter mythical creatures adventure and a battle between good and evil.
